summary: Standalone roles can be migrated into collections on Galaxy to distribute many roles together and share plugins; this is required for certified content and needs a Galaxy namespace to import.
questions: Why should I move my roles into a collection?
Do I have to use a collection to publish certified roles?

answer_card.title: Why migrate roles to collections
answer_card.answer_md: Collections let you ship many roles as one unit and share plugins across them instead of duplicating `library/` dirs. Migrating is **required** to distribute roles as certified content. Importing to Galaxy needs a Galaxy namespace.
